text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on a 
monthly bases as indicated by M1in the title block
Technical Specification:
AC input : 38010% 
 V ac, 50Hz, 3PH
 Admissible frequency fluctuations : 5%
DC output : 135V | Rated intensity (Idc):- 1600A
The first draft is initiated by eng. Eman El Henawey, tested by eng. Wageh 
Khalil, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by eng. 
Ali Zahran, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC. quality control 
general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of Nubaria 
power station and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageb quality control head 
sector
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued.
Switch off input & output supply.
Work order must be issued.
Switch off input & output supply.
Tools and Equipment
Suitable tool set
Digital voltmeter
Vacuum cleaner or blower brush
Suitable tool set
Digital voltmeter
Vacuum cleaner or blower brush
Work to be carried out
Switch - off input and output supply
Clean it from air dust and dirty
Check the ventilation system
Inspect over heating compartment of control board
Check fuses, contacts and terminal titling
Check performance of timers
Inspect visually the thyristor, IGBT`S and diodes
Switch on input and output supply
Check input and output voltage
Check the output current of battery charger and the battery current
Check connection and disconnection in case of fault in power supply
Check alarm & indication lamps
Check pulses of transistors or the wave form on the output bridge diodes (if 
 required)
Retain the battery charger to operation mode and close the work order
